name_input: UTTAM BLASTECH PRIVATE LIMITED; UTTAM BLASTECH PRIVATE LTD; UTTAM BLASTECH PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug 'uttam-blastech-private-limited', 78 records detected, 3 port lanes, latest cargo 2026-02-24) lists outbound records with the company as shipper: "2025-09-24 | UTTAM BLASTECH PRIVATE LIMITED | NITREX S R L | SHOCK TUBE INITIATOR SERIAL NO. 2025ST004 WITH ACCESSORIES CONTROL UNIT, SAFETYKEY FOR CONTROL UNIT, CHARGING ADAPTOR | HYDERABAD AIR CARGO, India -> MILAN MALPENSA, ITALY | HS 90159000 | BOL 7692561" and "2025-09-17 | UTTAM BLASTECH PRIVATE LIMITED | ASAS DRILLING SERVICES AND ROCK | UTTAM DIGITAL VOD AND DELAY TIMER SERIAL NO.2025VOD013 | HYDERABAD AIR CARGO, India -> MUSCAT, OMAN | HS 90318000 | BOL 8197536". Buyer-side counterparties also listed for Oman (M/S. Detonator Blasting & Contracting Co. LLC, 1 shipment) and UAE (Space Ambassadors Goods Wholesalers LLC, 1 shipment). Source counter: page header states 'Total Shipments 78 Records detected'; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 (3 inbound from Nomis Seismographs LLC, 2 outbound as above). Only 2 outbound rows were readable, so export volume is not quantifiable from the free view.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and volza/eximpedia/trademo free views returned HTTP 403, so domestic supply evidence was not verifiable in this pass. Not evidence of absence — simply not checked against a readable source.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: two dated outbound customs records (17.09.2025 to Muscat/Oman, 24.09.2025 to Milan/Italy) with HS codes and B/L numbers, plus named overseas buyers in Oman and UAE. Declared HS 360300 (prepared explosives) does NOT match the observed shipment HS codes — the actual records are 90159000 (parts of surveying/measuring instruments) and 90318000 (measuring/checking instruments), i.e. the company ships blast-monitoring and VOD/delay-timer equipment rather than the explosive compound itself; per project rules this is not a rejection ground, HS should be corrected to the factual codes (90159000 / 90318000) and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Note the same page shows the company is predominantly an IMPORTER (39+11+9+6 shipments from Nomis Seismographs LLC, 4 from Ideal Blasting Supply) — it buys seismographs and resells/rebrands equipment, so it is best classified as manufacturer_trader/unknown rather than a pure manufacturer. Revenue and export volume: null — the free view does not expose values and no public figure was found; not invented. Domestic supply: no traces found in readable sources, but search tooling was down, so recorded as unknown rather than none_found.
